notes.title: 2.0 now live
notes.content: When this was released in May we promised it's not the end, we've listened to the feedback from the community and today we released a 2.0 update. 2 of the rides got complete rework - Industrial is now way shorter, but with lot more content added, graphical and sound overhaul. The same applies for Bloody Mists, that now has ton of new stuff - and a lot of spiders as well, to play with fear even more. Hopefully you'll enjoy the new release.

notes.title: Speed and Scream now released
notes.content: I'm happy to be able finally share this with you, after working on it for 7 months. This is the spiritual successor to Desert Ride, featuring 4 rides in the initial release. This is also a somewhat 'early access' release and will be putting more work into it. So let us know what do you think, what you like and dislike. And enjoy the rides!
